item.title: They came for knowledge first: what 39 caregivers taught us at our first forum
item.description: Twenty-four feedback slips, three panellists, a room that filled slowly and 23 caregivers who put their names down for savings groups. What our first monthly forum at DCI Likoni CDC showed us, in numbers and in their own words.
